summary: Mansons Landing Seaplane Base (YMU) is a small water aerodrome situated on the sheltered waters of Mansons Landing, a quiet community on the southern end of Cortes Island in British Columbia, Canada. The base provides essential air access to this remote island in the Discovery Islands archipelago, where road connections to the mainland are absent. It primarily serves float-equipped aircraft offering scheduled and charter flights linking the island to Vancouver and other coastal destinations.
faqs:
Q: What type of aircraft use Mansons Landing Seaplane Base?
A: The base exclusively serves float-equipped seaplanes and amphibians, as it has no paved runways and operates on water only.

Q: Are there scheduled passenger flights available?
A: Yes, several regional operators offer scheduled floatplane services connecting Mansons Landing with Vancouver International Airport and other coastal points, though schedules may vary by season.

Q: Is the seaplane base open year-round?
A: Operations generally continue throughout the year, though weather conditions and rough seas can occasionally cause delays or cancellations during winter months.

Q: Are there any customs or immigration facilities?
A: No, as Mansons Landing is a domestic Canadian facility, there are no customs or immigration services available for international flights.
transport_tips: There are no roads connecting Cortes Island to the mainland, so the seaplane base is one of the primary ways to reach the island by air. Travelers can also reach Cortes Island by ferry from Quadra Island, followed by a short drive to Mansons Landing. Parking near the base is limited, so arranging pickup in advance is recommended for those arriving by ferry.
local_tip: Book flights for early morning when seas are typically calmest, and bring a waterproof bag for your belongings as you'll transfer directly from the dock to the floatplane by small boat or wading in shallow water.
